process.name: Enrich and Post Bank Remittance Transactions

notes: Three performer bands: Analyst (top) - Agent (middle) - System (bottom). The Agent mediates. read_access edges flow down from System to Agent (and person-retained reads from System to Analyst); handoff edges flow up from Agent to Analyst carrying draft/recommendation output; every write edge originates in the Analyst lane and targets a System surface. Control-flow sequence/then/else/merge/loop/exception edges connect acts and may cross lanes; the directional constraint governs the access, handoff, and write edges, not control-flow sequence. The System lane holds passive system_surface nodes and preserved system_result nodes; it performs nothing.

recommend-then-review (decision log 0014, ratified). The agent assembles the permitted evidence, applies only explicitly approved matching logic, and returns an evidence-backed recommended assessment as a draft, or an Escalation. The analyst reviews, holds every authoritative decision (with authority to override), and performs every system action. No decision node is agent-taken.

Access to every surface is an Assumed design condition for this exercise (decision log 0014, evt-0085), not a verified client entitlement. Availability is not an access grant. Each of the named surfaces carries an access disposition of More information required in the access-feasibility register; this graph upgrades none of them. Assumed access must never be represented as client-verified or production-ready.

The agent never clears, writes, saves, completes, applies, uploads, assigns, classifies, sends, performs outreach, or executes an operational Escalation in any system. No write edge originates from an Agent-lane node; the agent writes to nothing it does not own. Its only output leaves the lane via handoff to the agent review surface / Excel draft columns. Every write edge originates in the Analyst lane and targets a System surface (or, for the Excel classification and the Bank->CSV export, an Analyst-lane workspace with no System write edge). A single agent-originated write, or an agent-owned authoritative decision, is a critical violation.

The required threshold that separates a recommendation from an Escalation, and the ranking-calibration method for below-threshold possibilities, are deferred design inputs (decision log 0014, open items) and are More information required. They are not defined here. Where either would be outcome-determinative, the agent emits the evidence packet, the reason, and an Escalation rather than a recommendation; any ranked possibilities are explicitly labelled non-recommendatory.

nodes.title: Bank portal
nodes.detail: The remittance system of record. Read via read_access (agent transaction-detail read; person queue/verification reads; agent/person grid reads); written via write edges (ASSIGN, upload load, invoice-row entry, grid correction, Save, Mark Complete, workflow-status writes) that all originate in the Analyst lane.

nodes.title: Reconcile Against Assignment Workbook
nodes.detail: Unchanged current-state context. The analyst establishes the working set. The Excel workbook is the Analyst-lane workspace the interface reads context from; the Bank read is a person-retained read (read_access). Depth-capped.

facts.label: Finding
facts.text: The working set of rows to handle.

nodes.title: Select Working Row Block
nodes.detail: Analyst retained action. The analyst selects the row/block - this is the interface input under decision log 0014 (analyst-selected row + designated context is what the agent receives).

facts.label: Retrieves
facts.text: Transaction History filtered by Entity Name; the contiguous block of related entity rows (watching the VIEW/ASSIGN/WORKFLOW/EXPORT footer counters).

nodes.title: Assign Batch To Processor
nodes.detail: Analyst retained action. The ASSIGN write to Bank originates in the Analyst lane (write edge to sys-bank). The subsequent Bank->offline-CSV export is a retained analyst transfer to an Analyst-lane workspace (offline CSV), not a System surface, so it draws no write edge; the agent never assigns or exports.

facts.label: Enters
facts.text: Select a user, filter, select the current user, click ASSIGN so the selected rows route to the processor's workflow; confirm the 'N transactions were successfully assigned' toast.

nodes.title: Read Transaction Details (evidence)
nodes.detail: Agent evidence/reasoning contribution. Read-only (read_access to sys-bank). Agent participation is a future-state overlay under Assumed access; the underlying transaction-detail read is Observed in current state.

facts.label: Retrieves
facts.text: Transaction Details for the analyst-selected record: Payment Amount, Invoice Allocation, Difference, Status Enrichment Required, and the lower wire fields (Originator to Beneficiary, Wire Type, Beneficiary, Method of Payment).

nodes.title: Assemble Invoice Identity (Acme / ERP)
nodes.detail: Agent evidence/reasoning contribution; core cross-source identity assembly. Depth-capped: the graph records that approved matching logic is applied and a recommendation produced, not the rules. Read-only across all four surfaces (read_access). The ERP (receipts) consultation trigger (wwsntk-1), source-precedence on conflict (wwsntk-2), and cross-surface correlation/identity field (wwsntk-3) are More information required; where any would decide the outcome the agent Escalates rather than recommending. Agent participation is a future-state overlay under Assumed access.

facts.label: Inputs

facts.label: Compares
facts.text: Confirm the matching invoice identity for the payment across Invoicing app (Customer ID / Invoice#), resolving payer aliases via Company records app or Collections workbench on a validation error, and, where an ERP receipt check is needed, verifying the matching ERP (receipts) Receipts record as a validation read only.

facts.label: Cited evidence

facts.label: Recommends
facts.text: A proposed invoice identity for the payment (a recommendation, never the authoritative decision).

nodes.title: Corroborate Supporting Evidence
nodes.detail: Agent evidence/reasoning contribution. read_access to sys-bank-statement-report, sys-outlook, sys-uipath (System channels). The Excel Dashboard/workbook and the Foxit payment-advice PDF are Analyst-lane workspace reads passed as designated context through the Excel interface, not System reads, so they draw no read_access edge and are not written. Source-precedence (wwsntk-2) and cross-surface correlation (wwsntk-3) are More information required; where they would decide the outcome the agent Escalates. Depth-capped. Future-state overlay under Assumed access.

facts.label: Inputs

facts.label: Compares
facts.text: Confirm the payment against the Bank statement report highlighted credit line, Outlook payment-advice emails/PDFs, and - where the invoice split is not directly stated - the per-customer Dashboard / assignment workbook; bot-generated bank-statement output and UiPath remittance tasks are supporting evidence only.

facts.label: Cited evidence
facts.text: The corroborating credit line, advice, and invoice-split evidence, cited per source.

facts.label: Recommends
facts.text: A corroborated supporting-evidence basis feeding the recommended reconciliation packet (a recommendation input, never the authoritative decision).

facts.label: Feeds
facts.text: n-agent-stage-1

nodes.title: Stage Recommended Reconciliation Packet
nodes.detail: The clean placeholder for where judgment occurs -> person reviews. Output-only: the agent writes only to its own review surface / dedicated Excel draft columns (never a system of record, never a protected Excel field). Leaves the Agent lane by exactly one handoff edge to n-008. The concrete handoff-surface mechanism (a separate agent surface vs a designated Excel staging region) is a deferred Interface design decision. Proposed matching policy, pending Acme validation: exact 1:1 -> High recommendation; exact 2:1 / 3:1 -> Low recommendation; every other shape or ambiguity -> Escalation with evidence package. Recommended shapes identify analyst-owned manual entry; an Escalation carries no agent-selected method.

facts.label: Stages
facts.text: A draft review packet: the proposed invoice identity, the corroborated supporting evidence summary, a proposed allocation path including the recommended allocation method (UploadTemplate upload vs manual invoice-row entry), and the threshold state (met / not met); or, where the required threshold is not reached, an Escalation with the evidence packet, the reason, and only explicitly non-recommendatory ranked possibilities.

nodes.title: Check Bulk Upload Needed
nodes.detail: Shared review seam. The analyst reviews the staged packet and decides upload vs manual (authoritative decision, never agent-taken; authority to override). Branches preserved: then -> n-009 (upload), else -> n-011 (manual). Under the proposed matching policy pending Acme validation, recommended exact 1:1 / 2:1 / 3:1 shapes identify manual entry; every other shape or ambiguity arrives as an Escalation with evidence package and no agent-selected method.
nodes.condition: Is a one-to-many UploadTemplate upload the appropriate method?

nodes.title: Upload Remittance Template
nodes.detail: Analyst retained action. The agent may draft the staged UploadTemplate rows into its review surface / Excel draft columns, but never loads them; the analyst performs the upload write to Bank (write edge to sys-bank).

facts.label: Enters
facts.text: Load the staged invoice rows (staged in the prepared UploadTemplate file, preserving full invoice numbers) into the Bank remittance editor; confirm the 'N record(s) successfully uploaded. You must click the Save button to retain uploaded data' toast.

nodes.title: Stage Draft Balance Assessment
nodes.detail: Agent evidence/reasoning contribution, output-only. The agent reports whether its proposed allocation balances; the analyst at n-010 holds the authoritative balance decision (with authority to override) and performs every consequential action (Save, further correction). Output-only: the agent writes only to its own review surface / dedicated Excel draft columns, never a system of record, never a protected Excel field. No new agent system read is created to support this seam (invariant): the assessment is over the agent's own proposed allocation, carried forward from n-agent-stage-1 through the upload, not a read of the posted Bank Difference; the person-retained Difference read at n-010 is unchanged. Leaves the Agent lane by exactly one handoff edge (e-bal-hand) to n-010. Future-state overlay under Assumed access.

facts.label: Stages
facts.text: A draft-only balance assessment: whether the agent's own proposed allocation balances (nets to zero Difference against the Payment Amount) or does not, with the supporting figures already assembled in the recommended reconciliation packet. This is an assessment of the agent's proposed allocation, not a fresh read of the posted Bank Difference.

facts.label: Assesses
facts.text: the agent's proposed allocation carried forward from n-agent-stage-1 through the upload

nodes.title: Check Allocation Balanced
nodes.detail: Shared review seam. Legible binary on the Bank Difference value. The analyst reviews the agent's draft-only balance assessment (n-agent-balance, arriving via handoff e-bal-hand) and holds the authoritative balance decision (with authority to override); the person-retained Bank Difference read and any action stay with the analyst. No agent system read is created for this seam: the agent's assessment is over its own proposed allocation, not the posted Bank Difference. Branches preserved: then -> n-013 (balanced; agent reports balanced, analyst saves); else -> n-012-agent (unbalanced; routes into reconciliation).
nodes.condition: Does the uploaded remittance balance to zero difference?

nodes.title: Enter Invoice Rows
nodes.detail: Analyst retained action. Grid writes are retained (write edge to sys-bank); the agent may draft the rows for analyst entry but never writes the grid.

facts.label: Enters
facts.text: In the Bank remittance editor (New Rows / ADD / DELETE / DISASSOCIATE ADVICES) enter each confirmed invoice number and amount, building one-to-one, one-to-many, or many-to-one allocations until Invoice Allocation approaches the Payment Amount.

nodes.title: Propose Remaining-Difference Reconciliation
nodes.detail: Escalation/uncertainty seam (agent side); also the re-proposal target on re-entry (e-023) when the analyst intends a re-proposal, returning via e-hand-012 (F4). Read-only across sys-bank (grid state), sys-invoicing-app, sys-bank-statement-report, sys-outlook, sys-company-records-app (read_access); re-entry reuses these existing reads and creates no new agent system read/write. The agent never edits the grid, adds a Finance charge line, sets Reviewed status, or drafts the customer inquiry - all analyst retained actions. The confidence/stop threshold (wwsntk-4), eligibility boundary (wwsntk-5), completion-without-zero rule (wwsntk-6, Contradictory), and finance-charge/write-off tolerance (wwsntk-7) are unestablished; where any would decide the outcome the agent Escalates rather than recommending. It never silently converts an Escalation into a recommendation. Depth-capped. Future-state overlay under Assumed access.

facts.label: Inputs
facts.text: sys-bank (current grid / Difference) · sys-invoicing-app · sys-bank-statement-report · sys-outlook · sys-company-records-app

facts.label: Compares
facts.text: Examine the complete permitted evidence and, where the evidence and explicitly approved matching logic support it, propose the evidence-supported path to reconciliation for the remaining Difference (not only a one-to-one match).

facts.label: Cited evidence
facts.text: The assembled evidence packet with per-source citations and the resulting Difference position.

facts.label: Recommends
facts.text: A proposed reconciliation path / disposition and its threshold state, or - where the required threshold is not reached - an Escalation (evidence packet, reason, and only explicitly non-recommendatory ranked possibilities).

facts.label: Feeds
facts.text: n-012-analyst

nodes.title: Reconcile Remaining Difference (review, correct, disposition)
nodes.detail: Escalation/uncertainty seam (analyst side) and the actor for every system action here. The analyst performs all Bank grid writes (add/adjust/remove rows, Finance charge line, Reviewed status) - write edge to sys-bank - and drafts the customer-facing remittance inquiry from the Notepad template with a Snipping Tool credit-line capture (an analyst retained action; Snipping Tool and Notepad are Analyst-lane workspace tools). The person-retained grid read is a read_access to sys-bank; the analyst reviews the agent's cited evidence packet rather than re-reading every source. The self-loop e-022 is analyst-performed iterative correction; where re-proposal is intended the agent is re-invoked via the explicit re-entry edge e-023 (n-012-analyst -> n-012-agent) and re-proposes back through the existing Agent->Analyst review handoff e-hand-012 (F4). Every system correction and loop action remains analyst-performed. The outbound remittance inquiry is addressed to the customer Accounts Payable mailbox (internal Payments in Cc) via Outlook; its send is left unsent / out of scope, so no write edge into a channel is asserted. Threshold, eligibility boundary, and disposition-selection rule are More information required (wwsntk-4, wwsntk-5); the completion-without-zero rule is Contradictory (wwsntk-6, preserved not resolved).

facts.label: Inputs
facts.text: n-012-agent (proposed path or Escalation) · sys-bank (grid)

facts.label: Compares
facts.text: Review the agent's proposed reconciliation path (or Escalation) and iteratively add, adjust, or remove invoice rows in the Bank grid until Difference reaches 0.00, adding a Finance charge line where a small bank-charge residual must be absorbed or resetting an over-applied allocation, then select the disposition.

facts.label: Finding
facts.text: One of several materially distinct dispositions, each an explicit route out of this node.

nodes.title: Save Remittance Update
nodes.detail: Analyst retained action. Save originates in the Analyst lane (write edge to sys-bank).

facts.label: Enters
facts.text: Click Save; confirm the 'Save Successful / Reference items were successfully updated' toast and the status change to Enrichment Complete.

nodes.title: Confirm Mark Complete
nodes.detail: Analyst retained action. Complete originates in the Analyst lane (write edge to sys-bank).

facts.label: Enters
facts.text: Click MARK COMPLETE, confirm YES in the modal, wait for the record to reload in Enrichment Complete status with 0 open advices.

nodes.title: Record Enrichment Complete (0 open advices)
nodes.detail: Unchanged current-state context; system-produced terminal state, preserved not inferred. Contradictory: records reach this completion state without full invoice backing or with an unresolved / documented residual, conflicting with the stated 'Difference 0.00 / invoice-backed / 0 open advices' success criterion. The completion-without-zero condition feeds the Escalation/uncertainty seam via wwsntk-6; it is preserved, never converted into a completion rule.

nodes.title: Verify Completed Record & Set Workflow Status
nodes.detail: Analyst retained action. Both Bank workflow writes (assign-to-processor; Update Workflow Statuses to Reviewed) originate in the Analyst lane (two write edges to sys-bank). The verification read is a person-retained read_access to sys-bank; the agent may contribute the verification read as evidence, but that contribution is not asserted as a separate node here.

facts.label: Enters
facts.text: Confirm Enrichment Complete and invoice-backed rows in Transaction History (read); assign the completed record to the responsible processor (Workflow & Notes > Select a user); batch-set completed rows to Reviewed via WORKFLOW > Update Workflow Statuses; review Receivables > Reports > Assigned-to Summary for queue oversight.

nodes.title: Classify Assignment Tracker Row
nodes.detail: Analyst retained action targeting the Analyst-lane Excel workspace, so it draws no System write edge. The classification column is a protected operational-status field: the agent must not write it. The agent may draft-propose a class into a dedicated draft column only, but the tracker-classification taxonomy authority and class-selection rule are More information required (gap #9), so where they would decide the class the agent Escalates rather than recommending.

facts.label: Enters
facts.text: Mark the matching workbook row 'completed' and set the payment-type classification in the column U/V/W dropdown (Data Validation list sourced from Sheet1); correct entries that trigger the data-validation restriction error; align rows against the exported CSV.

nodes.title: Item Left In Reviewed / Unidentified Status
nodes.detail: Escalation/uncertainty seam. Off-spine disposition, preserved not inferred: an unidentified item is moved to Reviewed status and left, rather than proceeding to Enrichment Complete. Closure, eligibility boundary, confidence threshold, and any Bank->MOA hand-off are More information required (wwsntk-5, wwsntk-4, gap #10). No onward edge is asserted.

nodes.title: Remittance Inquiry Drafted (Reviewed / On account / Sent email)
nodes.detail: Escalation/uncertainty seam. Off-spine disposition, preserved not inferred: where no invoice match can be confirmed a customer-facing remittance inquiry is drafted and the item is left Reviewed / On account / Sent email. The outbound email and outreach are analyst retained actions; the send is left unsent / out of scope. Closure, eligibility boundary, and any Bank->MOA hand-off are More information required (wwsntk-5, gap #10). No onward edge is asserted.

decision_tables.treatment_note: The agent proposes a reconciliation path only where evidence and approved logic permit; otherwise it Escalates with an evidence packet and reason. Every disposition (e-014, e-019, e-020, e-021) and the self-loop (e-022) is analyst-performed. Where the analyst intends a re-proposal, re-entry to the agent is the explicit control-flow edge e-023 (n-012-analyst -> n-012-agent), returning via the existing Agent->Analyst review handoff e-hand-012; re-entry creates no new agent system read/write (F4). The six correction/disposition rows map to the preserved Layer-1 edges out of n-012; no route is created or concealed. Escalation: Threshold, eligibility boundary, disposition-selection rule, and finance-charge tolerance are unestablished; the completion-without-zero rule is Contradictory (preserved). The agent never silently converts an Escalation into a recommendation.
